title: Detalle de tarea en Mis Tareas (sheet lateral)
brief: Right-side sheet for collaborators in Mis Tareas: task + description at assignment, status, time, Drive link, project link (new tab), project notes, previous-task history with eye toggle for notes and deliverable; opens on task click or 'Tomar tarea'.

artboards.title: Sheet con pestañas
artboards.tradeoff: Very clean and familiar (Resumen / Notas / Historial); notes and history are one click away, not in view

artboards.title: Guía en 3 pasos (un solo scroll)
artboards.tradeoff: Reads like a checklist (entiende → recursos → antecedentes) with a prominent timer; more scrolling and a brand-colored header

artboards.title: Panel de trabajo dividido
artboards.tradeoff: Everything visible at once (brief + notes left, time/links/history right); wide sheet covers most of the list and needs a stacked fallback on small screens

artboards.title: Barra en el encabezado
artboards.tradeoff: Time and Drive/Proyecto live in one header row; history gets the whole right rail. Header row gets busy on narrow sheets

artboards.title: Rail compacto con resumen
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the shipped layout: links as a slim two-part button, time as a small key/value list; rail still holds three kinds of content

artboards.title: Dock inferior
artboards.tradeoff: Most room for task, notes and history; Drive/Proyecto become icon buttons with tooltips next to the actions, less discoverable for new collaborators
